messages:
maria: Heads-up — paging integration seems to be dropping a subset of on-call recipients for EU region. Got two customer reports within the last 10m. inc-bot shows partial fanout when it should be full.
inc-bot: Automated alert: incident created INC-4512. fanout_status=partial (2/3), last_heartbeat=1839989900, queued=3
sre_ash: Seeing 502s from automation-gateway in the last 5m to notify-relay. Worker eu-gw-2 returning TLS handshake errors intermittently.
jonathan: Any recent deploys to automation-gateway? If yes, what ID so we can roll back quickly.
maria: deploy-id: deploy-2026-03-19-0827 — last rollout was a config change to batching/timeout heuristics.
oncall_tia: i'm oncall — i'll take ownership. please post quick mitigation steps and any manual paging workarounds. tagging @support-liz for customer calls :phone:
support-liz: CS update: two enterprise customers (AcmeCorp, FinchHealth) reported pages not reaching SMS and delayed voice pages (~5-8m). They're on standby; we opened support tickets and called primary contacts.
eng-platform-ryan: we can toggle the fallback route to force notify-relay direct fanout. I'm prepping a quick patch to the routing policy. Command I'll run:
```
POST https://orch.internal/routing/force_fallback
{ "region": "eu", "target": "notify-relay-primary" }
```
jonathan: If we flip fallback, will it double-send for recipients that did get through earlier? Need idempotency check.
sre_ash: good q. current fanout layer should be idempotent, but the gateway mis-handled partial ACKs — I see EPIPE to sms-gw-2 in logs. snippet:
```
[1839989952] fanout=2/3 send->sms-gw-2 error="write EPIPE"
[1839989953] fallback queued to notify-relay-primary
```
maria: @eng-platform-ryan go ahead with fallback, coordinate with @oncall_tia to avoid duplicate pages. ops teams will annotate tickets.
eng-platform-ryan: fallback toggle executed. observe: pages resumed and customers report deliveries starting again. inc-bot still shows fanout=partial for 12m window, likely stale state.
inc-bot: Status update: fanout=3/3 now, incident INC-4512 -> mitigated (partial), auto-metrics flagged mismatch between gateway heartbeats and orchestration healthchecks.
oncall_tia: manual follow-up: I'll keep monitoring for 30m, will escalate to P1 if any more customer reports or if fanout returns to partial. Also need a runbook item: add healthcheck on gateway to detect write EPIPE patterns earlier.
sre_ash: root cause hypothesis: recent batching/timeout config in deploy-2026-03-19-0827 reduced per-connection keepalive, exposing a race with sms-gw-2 TLS session reuse. Plan: revert batching timeout to previous value and add connection healthcheck + retries.
maria: Customer impact summary (prelim): AcmeCorp and FinchHealth experienced delayed or missing pages for ~4-8 minutes; no confirmed missed escalations yet. CS already notified customers. No page-related incidents opened by customers beyond support tickets.
support-liz: customers informed, they accepted workaround and asked for postmortem and timeline.
oncall_tia: Action items: 1) revert deploy-2026-03-19-0827 config (jonathan), 2) add gateway healthcheck and alert on fanout < 100% (eng-platform-ryan), 3) update inc-bot to surface partial fanout immediately to oncall instead of aggregated windows (maria). I'll own the follow-up and postmortem.
maria: thanks all — i'll create the postmortem doc and assign owners to the action items. closing thread for live triage, will reopen if new customer impact reported. :white_check_mark:
